summary: The exact candidate is test/report-only and passes its three direct helper cases, but it codifies position 0 as correct for every None mamba_next_track_idx. An independent GPU case based on the real free/overlap lifecycle showed that a freed lingering row resolves to a stale positive cache slot, so later verify commit code can write stale recurrent state rather than skipping the row. The candidate prevents the reported tensor-construction TypeError in the prepared source but does not establish a safe or full original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression executed the actual imported helper on gfx950; all 3 candidate cases passed.
The candidate test also passed unchanged on the recorded base, confirming the candidate adds no runtime fix and only hardens existing behavior.
A freed/lingering None row selected stale slot 101 instead of skip sentinel -1, while the adjacent live row correctly selected 202.
Review report changes contain no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 ran candidate and adversarial helper cases on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_counterexamples: When free_mamba_cache or reset_for_retract has cleared mamba_next_track_idx but an overlap-lagged TARGET_VERIFY row remains, the current fallback gathers slot 0 from stale mapping data instead of marking the row skipped; observed actual output [101, 202] versus safe expected [-1, 202].
The downstream update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify path does not mask last_correct_step_indices for these freed rows, so a non-track commit can also target a stale-but-in-range state slot.
remaining_limitations: The NVIDIA H20 architecture, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 weights, EAGLE draft model, exact launch configuration, and sustained concurrent serving workload were unavailable.

No full-model, HTTP-serving, NVIDIA FA3, semantic-accuracy, or soak reproduction was possible; the deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify this hybrid Qwen/Mamba workload and was not substituted.
GPU evidence is limited to the Python scheduler-helper and lifecycle counterexample on one AMD gfx950 device.
No native source changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json declares native null, and imports resolved to /job/repo/python; no native rebuild was required.
